AC-1: The evolve/ workspace layout is implemented as deterministic CLI machinery: raw/<run-id>/ write-once traces, wiki/ with append-only logs.md and skill-impact.md, proposals/ overlays, and the PURPOSE.md convention (master §3a three-layer workspace, §6-B1).

AC-2: The audit-entry schema (metadata, target skill, unified diff, score, Accepted/Rejected — append-only, never rolled back) and the judgment-record schema from master §5.4 ({judgment_id, run_id, candidate_overlay_sha256, skill_under_test, task_set_id, task_set_version, judge_model, rubric_sha256, per_criterion_scores[], weighted_aggregate, verdict, cost_usd, recorded_at, recorder}) are delivered as versioned schemas; judgment records live under evolve/raw/<run-id>/.

AC-3: Structural tests (node --test) plus golden fixtures prove layout invariants, write-once enforcement, append-only enforcement and schema rejection of malformed records; red-leg mutation proof per §4.7 in .ai/evidence/tswc-ac-b1.json.

AC-4: D_train/D_val split and frozen-D_val-per-cycle semantics (evalset version stamped on task sets; scores never compared across versions) and the held-out T_test reservation are representable in the task-set schema (master §5.4).

AC-1: `ai-catapult evolve --validate` implements WikiSkill Eq. 4 over recorded judgments: accept iff R(T_val,k) > R_best; early-stop iff R_best = 1.0 (weighted aggregate at rubric maximum); else revert to S_{k-1} and drop the overlay (master §3a, §6-B3). No threshold is cited to the paper (§3a boundary).

AC-2: Seeding honors F1 (master §4.9): S_0 = current catalog state and R_best = the current skill set's validation score — never a skill-disabled baseline; S_{k-1} = last accepted state; reject drops the overlay while the wiki keeps its learnings (append-only structurally, even on reject).

AC-3: Provenance is enforced (master §5.4): a judgment not bound to candidate_overlay_sha256 + task_set_version + judge_model is refused with judgment_unbound; unrecorded invocations surface as attribution gaps in the audit entry.

AC-4: Spend veto (master §5.5): recorded per-cycle cost_usd is summed and the gate refuses to dispatch or accept past $100/cycle with cycle_budget_exhausted; robustness prefers 3 samples + majority/mean within the ceiling.

AC-5: Unit vectors cover accept, reject, early-stop, revert, unbound-reject and budget-exhaust; a negative fixture (mutation) proves each refusal fires (§4.7). TDD evidence in .ai/evidence/tswc-ac-b3.json.
AC-6: The command is deterministic CLI machinery with no runtime LLM dependency (master §3d); judge calls stay out-of-band human runs (§4.4).

AC-1: Accept path: an accepted overlay flows as an atomic single-skill PR to the skills/ SSOT, then a skills.lock.json SHA bump, then revendor and per-host payload rebuilds (resolveBundledSkills, fail-closed) — the §3c pipeline direction, never in-place skill mutation.
AC-2: Reject path: the overlay is dropped and the wiki keeps its learnings; no upstream write occurs on reject (master §3c, §6-B4).
AC-3: The lock bump is a runtime action of the flow, batched per mega-plan §2.3; implementation-time scope excludes skills.lock.json and vendor/.

AC-4: E2E proof is a fixture run through the opencode-e2e-style harness (local fixture repo + stub upstream): the full accept flow and the reject flow both run green; red-leg fixture proves a broken handoff (e.g. mutated lock SHA) is refused (§4.7). TDD evidence in .ai/evidence/tswc-ac-b4.json.

AC-5: All harness payloads stay parity-clean for the §3e harness set (OMC/OMX consume claude/codex payloads; OpenCode v2 rides payload merges + commands/skills, never the v2 plugin array; omo-ai standalone only).
AC-1: Structural/complexity pre-reject runs on proposed skill scripts before any judge invocation: a gnarly proposal costs zero judge dollars (master §5.5 mechanism 1, §6-B5).
AC-2: The OKF v0.3 frontmatter check (name/description present) rides as findings-only advisory output; it never blocks and never emits okf_version:"0.3" (master §3b).
AC-3: A stub judge harness asserts zero invocations on the gnarly fixture proposal; red-leg fixture per §4.7 in .ai/evidence/tswc-ac-b5.json.

AC-4: Pre-reject uses the A-gates: this lane's A2 gate stack (strict tsc, eslint complexity 10, sonarjs cognitive-complexity 15) plus the skills-lane A4 gates (ruff C901 10, xenon, shellcheck, shfmt) over proposed skill scripts — the gates are consumed, not redefined (master §4.2 thresholds).
